confirmedFindings.title: Bidirectional Lock Inversion Deadlock in Jitter Buffer
confirmedFindings.body: insertPacket acquires packetMutex then queueMutex while getNextPlayoutFrame acquires queueMutex then packetMutex. Under high packet arrival rates, this lock inversion triggers a permanent deadlock freezing the audio playout thread.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Enforce strict, uniform lock hierarchy: always acquire packetMutex before queueMutex.
